items.headline: Camping World (NYSE:CWH) reports sales below analyst estimates in Q3 2026 earnings, stock drops 11.9%
items.summary: Recreational vehicle and boat retailer Camping World (NYSE:CWH) missed Wall Street's revenue expectations in Q3 2026, with revenue falling 12.4% year on year to $1.58 billion. Its non-GAAP loss of $0.19 per share was significantly below analysts' consensus estimates.
